description: Without number_id: Add a number. With number_id: Change a number.

account_sid.description:
The Twilio account that owns the number: the main account or a subaccount, `AC...`;
left out or null, the main account. Inbound messages to it carry this account.

channels.description: Where the number works: `sms`, `whatsapp` or both.

inbound_fallback_url.description: Called when the reply webhook fails, with `ErrorCode` and `ErrorUrl` added.

inbound_method.description: The HTTP method of the reply webhook; POST when left out, as on Twilio.

inbound_template_id.description: Payload template for the inbound webhook, e.g. `twilio.inbound_sms`.

inbound_url.description: Reply webhook (Twilio "A message comes in"); null means rules only.

label.description: A name for the number, e.g. the app or feature that uses it.

messaging_service_sid.description: The Messaging Service this number belongs to, `MG...`; null for none.

number.description: E.164, without a channel prefix; `channels` says whether WhatsApp works.

opt_out_keywords.description:
Whether a text of STOP to this number opts the contact out (Twilio's Advanced
Opt-Out, with the provider's switch on); on when left out.

status_callback_url.description: Your app's URL for status changes of messages sent from this number.

name: sendmock_number_upsert
